svg.title: MR-1 wiring schematic on the Octopus Pro v1.1 board
svg.desc: The official BIGTREETECH Octopus Pro V1.1 pin drawing with every connector used by the MR-1 build outlined and routed to what it connects to: four CL57T drives, alarm relays, homes, probe, operator inputs, spindle, coolant and power. Planning drawing; dashed HOLD items are not designed or qualified.

text.tspan: Octopus Pro v1.1 → 4 × CL57T V4.1 closed loop · every used connector, routed

svg.text: PLANNING DRAWING — NOT APPROVAL TO ENERGIZE OR MOVE. Dashed = HOLD (not yet designed or qualified). Printed names on the real board and parts win over this page.
No board photo here? GitHub cannot load
the linked BIGTREETECH image. Open a
downloaded copy of this file in a browser.
MOTOR0: STEP PF13 (7) · DIR PF12 (8) · GND (9)
P1 ALM → relay K-X A2 · COM− → ALM 0V
P2 ← encoder DB15, 6 wires; braid NOT on P2
thin black = EA+; P2 VCC is a drive output
P3 → motor GX16: A+ A− B+ B− (pins 1–4)
P4 ← 36 V F-X: +VDC / GND, POLARIZED, ≤ 50 V
ENA, BRK open. STEP/DIR float in MCU reset:
36 V OFF to reset or flash. Motor + encoder on.
MOTOR1: STEP PG0 (7) · DIR PG1 (8) · GND (9)
P1 ALM → relay K-YL A2 · COM− → ALM 0V
P2 ← encoder DB15, 6 wires; braid NOT on P2
thin black = EA+; P2 VCC is a drive output
P3 → motor GX16: A+ A− B+ B− (pins 1–4)
P4 ← 36 V F-YL: +VDC / GND, POLARIZED, ≤ 50 V
ENA, BRK open. STEP/DIR float in MCU reset:
36 V OFF to reset or flash. Motor + encoder on.
MOTOR2: STEP PF11 (7) · DIR PG3 (8) · GND (9)
P1 ALM → relay K-Z A2 · COM− → ALM 0V
P2 ← encoder DB15, 6 wires; braid NOT on P2
thin black = EA+; P2 VCC is a drive output
P3 → motor GX16: A+ A− B+ B− (pins 1–4)
P4 ← 36 V F-Z: +VDC / GND, POLARIZED, ≤ 50 V
ENA, BRK open. STEP/DIR float in MCU reset:
36 V OFF to reset or flash. Motor + encoder on.
MOTOR3: STEP PG4 (7) · DIR PC1 (8) · GND (9)
P1 ALM → relay K-YR A2 · COM− → ALM 0V
P2 ← encoder DB15, 6 wires; braid NOT on P2
thin black = EA+; P2 VCC is a drive output
P3 → motor GX16: A+ A− B+ B− (pins 1–4)
P4 ← 36 V F-YR: +VDC / GND, POLARIZED, ≤ 50 V
ENA, BRK open. STEP/DIR float in MCU reset:
36 V OFF to reset or flash. Motor + encoder on.
A1 A2 B2 B1 motor-output plugs: EMPTY (all 8)
HV / VM / VIN jumper caps: REMOVE (all 8)
M0–M7 DIAG caps: REMOVE (they sit on the
No plug-in driver or socket adapter fitted.
Dual-channel E-stop → safety relay. On stop:
· contactor opens 36 V: Z brake / support
· coolant pump and air supply cut
· 24 V control stays ON so PF3 / PB1 report
36 V S-360-36 → 4 star branches, fused at PSU
→ each CL57T P4. 50 V hard max. Never Octopus.
VCC_IO +5 V (blue dot) → F_CMD 0.5 A fast
One takeoff only. Remove J68 (USB power).
+24 V → +VIN · 0 V → GND (read the board marks)
24 V only, 28 V max. 36 V kills the board.
Also feeds PS-ALM and the interposing relays.
All EMPTY. Drive power never touches the board.
HE1 · PA3 → mist / air relay coil
Coil across HE+ (fused VIN) and switched HE−.
HE− never to GND. Supplies in the stop chain.
Octopus GND = DRIVER0 GND = CTRL_0V: one net
ALM 0V: PS-ALM −Vo → all CL57T COM−, floating
EGND: each CL57T P2 → its own encoder only
Probe / home ISO 0V: floating, never HGND
Never join these because they say GND.
Bond backplate, frame, rail, spindle, drives.
Octopus on nylon standoffs. PE is never a return.
3.3 V → TB-C3: five 2.2 kΩ alarm pull-ups
PB8, PB9 empty. HGND never to field GND.
Data only. Remove J68 for cabinet use.
EXP2 (find it by its board marking)
+ series R, TVS, 3.3 V pull-up, RC
onboard SW2 (BOOT1) shares PB2: guard it
RST is also on EXP2: keyed IDC only.
Other pin of each header = GND return
Dashed card or line: not yet designed
ALL FOUR CL57T: SET WITH POWER OFF
2. 36 V into MAIN POWER: kills the board
3. S3 on 5V with 24 V signals: kills the input
4. Raw ALM, stock 5 V or 24 V on any GPIO
5. Hot-plugging P3 motor or P4 power
6. Over 50 V on the motion bus: kills drives
Each outlined connector has one line to a
card listing what lands on each of its pins.
Top: the four driver sockets → CL57T drives.
Red dashed: leave empty or remove.
Dashed card + line: HOLD, not yet designed.
Outlines follow BTT’s V1.1 drawing; it prints
no socket numbers: M0–M3 = MOTOR0–3 per BTT.
Confirm socket names, STOP rows and pin 1
on the real board before crimping.
Converter / coil across FAN+ and switched
Read each FAN rail jumper (5 / 12 V / VIN).
DB44 map is community-sourced: meter it.
Never land Octopus pins on the DB44.
Enable contact in series with safety permit.
A2 → that drive’s ALM · COM− → PS-ALM −Vo
ALM must conduct when healthy: prove each.
21–24 → PG12 X · PG13 YL · PG14 Z · PG15 YR
STOP4–7 SIG pins only; return via EXP2 GND
2.2 kΩ to 3.3 V + 100 nF to GND on all 5 inputs
SIG + GND each; every STOP 5 V pin EMPTY.
not approved), or direct only for verified
bare NC contacts. Split the stock shared
Y2/Z circuit into four channels first.
